question: Which merchants had the most failed payments last week?

plan.question: Which merchants had the most failed payments last week?
plan.sql:
SELECT m.display_name, t.merchant_id, COUNT(*) AS failed
FROM analytics.transactions t
JOIN analytics.merchants m ON m.merchant_id = t.merchant_id
WHERE t.status = 'FAILED' AND t.txn_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-11-13' AND DATE '2026-11-19'
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY failed DESC
LIMIT 10
